evidence.label: Balance-sheet identity
evidence.claim: Reserves rose $17.9B on the week to $2,948B, and the ledger says where from: the residual released $35.1B, the foreign RRP pool absorbed $30.1B, the TGA spent down $28.4B, six legs summing to the reserve change to the dollar with $2.4B of the balance sheet, 0.04% of assets, still sitting in the unnamed residual.

evidence.label: Official-sector footprint
evidence.claim: Foreign officials cut their Fed custody Treasuries by $43.5B over 13 weeks while foreign RRP parking rose by $12.9B, only a partial rotation because the combined official footprint still fell $30.6B to $2,933B, 70% of the custody drop leaving the official sector rather than moving inside it.
evidence.source: Federal Reserve custody and foreign RRP
